-# Complete the required API and report.
+"""Configuration layer evaluation for the work sample."""
+
+import re
+
+_INTEGER = re.compile(r"[+-]?\d+\Z")
+
+
+def _failure(code):
+    return {"ok": False, "config": {}, "error": code}
+
+
+def _environment_value(value, expected_type):
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        return False, None
+    if expected_type == "boolean":
+        if value == "true":
+            return True, True
+        if value == "false":
+            return True, False
+        return False, None
+    if expected_type == "integer":
+        if _INTEGER.fullmatch(value) is None:
+            return False, None
+        return True, int(value, 10)
+    if expected_type == "string":
+        return True, value
+    return False, None
+
+
+def _has_exact_type(value, expected_type):
+    if expected_type == "boolean":
+        return type(value) is bool
+    if expected_type == "integer":
+        return type(value) is int
+    if expected_type == "string":
+        return type(value) is str
+    return False
+
+
+def evaluate(request, policy):
+    """Apply layers in order, followed by optional environment overrides."""
+    defaults = policy.get("defaults", {})
+    expected_types = policy.get("types", {})
+    config = dict(defaults)
+    known_keys = set(defaults)
+
+    for layer in request.get("layers", []):
+        for key, value in layer.items():
+            if key not in known_keys:
+                return _failure("unknown_key")
+            if value is None and policy.get("null_resets") is True:
+                config[key] = defaults[key]
+            else:
+                config[key] = value
+
+    environment = request.get("environment", {})
+    if environment:
+        if policy.get("environment") is not True:
+            return _failure("environment")
+        for key, value in environment.items():
+            if key not in known_keys:
+                return _failure("environment")
+            valid, parsed = _environment_value(value, expected_types.get(key))
+            if not valid:
+                return _failure("environment")
+            config[key] = parsed
+
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        if not _has_exact_type(value, expected_types.get(key)):
+            return _failure("type")
+
+    return {"ok": True, "config": config, "error": None}
